coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 12 of 17 ground-truth variable items (71%): data splitting, sequence and prediction lengths, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, RevIN usage, synthetic-data parameters, normalization, cycle indexing, MSE, and MAE.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW instead of the specified Adam optimizer. Does not specify the single RTX 4090 with 24GB memory, the 30-epoch training limit, or an experimental batch-size setting; mentioning feasible batches of at least 128 is not a defined training setting. Omits training-loss and learned-cycle visualizations as measured outputs.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to identify the expected trained CycleNet forecasting model and visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
